base_prompt_prefix: 2D animated cartoon style, flat shading, clean bold outlines, simple but expressive character designs, educational history animation aesthetic, vibrant but historically appropriate colors
base_prompt_suffix: high quality illustration, consistent art style, no text in image

character_rules.face: simple expressive features, dot eyes or almond eyes, small nose
character_rules.clothing: historically accurate but simplified for animation style

background_rules.detail_level: medium - detailed enough for context, simple enough for 2D style
background_rules.perspective: mostly flat or slight perspective, avoid extreme 3D angles
background_rules.colors: muted earth tones for backgrounds, characters pop against background

camera_shots.establishing: wide shot showing location and era
camera_shots.dialogue: medium shot, 2 characters facing each other

negative_prompts: realistic, 3D render, photorealistic, photograph, blurry, low quality, text, watermark, modern elements, anime style, manga style, chibi, pixel art
